summary.name: ChatGPT Sidebar (Sider)
summary.one_liner: A gallery page from the Sider product family showing user-made browser scripts (for YouTube, X, Reddit, Gemini, ChatGPT, Google Search and others) that can be applied to websites in one click.
keywords: make the web work your way
use_cases: Add picture-in-picture shortcut to YouTube videos
Set daily time limits on X
Show Amazon price history next to product price
summary.what_it_does: The page is a gallery of scripts made with Sider Code, shown with weekly picks and an all-scripts list. Each entry lists a target site, a short description, a usage count, and an Applied label. Examples include a YouTube picture-in-picture shortcut (Alt+P), a daily X usage limit with reminders and lock screen, a Reddit summary of up to 40 top comments, and a YouTube ad skipper. The page says users can create their own script from one sentence and apply it in one click, keeping every change under their control. The page also mentions Web Creator and Deep Research in its meta description, but the body text does not describe them.
notable: Scripts are generated from a single sentence with Sider Code and applied in one click
Large library of community scripts for sites like YouTube, X, Reddit, Gemini, ChatGPT, Google and Amazon
Each script can be turned on or off, and changes stay under the user's control
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Scripts depend on the target websites' layouts and may break when those sites change
